'''2000 Wizard World Open''' was a Star Wars CCG Open championship on Decipher's 2000 summer convention circuit. The winner received a bye to the semifinal round of the World Championship and travel to DecipherCon 2000.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sc00ww">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/wizardworld.html Decipher's @ Wizard World 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000817231222/http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/summercons2000/wizardworld.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Jared Lockwood]] of Churubusco, Indiana won.<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Open championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 4 August 2000<ref name="tr-d1081" /> (the convention ran 4–6 August 2000)
* '''Site:''' Wizard World, Chicago, Illinois; Rosemont Convention Center, Rosemont (Chicago), Illinois<ref name="tr-d1081" />
